correctness.rationale: For P~PD(0,theta), theta>0, iid draws and K_n distinct species, H(P)=-sum_i P_i log P_i, use discovery increment I_{n+1}. Given P, E I_{n+1}=sum_i P_i(1-P_i)^n. First two size-biased GEM variables V1,V2 iid Beta(1,theta) yield equal-species part E[-V1 log V1 (1−V1)^n] and distinct-species part E[(1−V1)^{n+1}(−log[(1−V1)V2])]. Direct beta differentiation gives formulas A_n=theta/((theta+n)(theta+n+1))[psi(theta+n+2)−psi(2)] and B_n=theta/(theta+n+1)^2+theta/(theta+n+1)[psi(theta+1)−psi(1)]. Subtract theta/(theta+n)EH and simplify to Cov(I_{n+1},H)=theta/((theta+n)(theta+n+1))sum_{j=1}^n 1/(theta+j), strictly positive. From K1=1, telescoping/summation-by-parts gives finite covariance theta[sum_{k=1}^{n−1}(theta+k)^{-2}−(theta+n)^{-1}sum_{k=1}^{n−1}(theta+k)^{-1}] and trigamma form, with limit theta psi1(theta+1). Independently evaluated the distinct special-function and finite-sum expressions for theta=0.3,1,2.5 and n=1,2,4,10,100 at 35 decimal-digit precision. Under DP Chinese-restaurant independent new-table Bernoulli indicators, Var(K_n)~theta log n; JMLR's exact prior entropy variance V_H=theta/(theta+1)^2+psi1(2)/(theta+1)−psi1(theta+2) yields the claimed scaled correlation limit. n1 zero. Finite calculations do not replace analytic proof.

originality.rationale: Distinguishes joint prior-predictive Cov(K_n,H(P)) from posterior entropy estimates, fixed-P accumulation identities and joint richness with unbiased Gini–Simpson. Archer–Park–Pillow give prior H moments and posterior H conditional on frequency counts; Cerquetti's Bayesian diversity moments concern Tsallis indexes and diversity posterior. Neither examined scientific passage directly provides the finite-n unconditional K_n-H covariance or its exact saturation/correlation constant, despite potentially implying it after a new joint moment calculation. Best-of-knowledge PASS with a concrete terminology-equivalence risk.
residual_risks: Although Cerquetti's relevant prior/posterior sections were inspected in a full accessible arXiv PDF, an unrecognized consequence of its Gibbs-weight formulas or different index terminology remains a bibliographic possibility.
More general species-estimation EPPF posterior calculations may imply this as a corollary without explicitly presenting the formula.
Only PD(0,theta) and prior-predictive covariance are proved; no positive Pitman–Yor discount or posterior covariance extension.
Independent high-precision test cross-checks stated closed expressions, not GEM sampling over all positive theta/n.

value.rationale: Quantifies a genuine distinction between unboundedly varying richness and a bounded absolute information-association with the random latent Shannon diversity under a benchmark Dirichlet-process prior. Exact monotone n law, saturation ceiling and correlation decay constant are jointly useful for assessing richness as an entropy proxy and prior predictive uncertainty, beyond the standard mean/variance of H alone.
